title: Big photos (16K) make History unusable: canvas lags, masks near impossible to draw
description: Fabio's photographer tester (RTX 3060 12 GB, 16 GB RAM) edits 16K images easily in Adobe apps; in Cubric Studio the whole UI lags, mask strokes are near impossible and the app stalls. Research first: measure where the time and memory go on a real 16K file, then pick techniques (display proxy / mip levels, tiled drawing, worker-side pixel work, full-res only at Apply on the server). Brief in brief.md.
